[b]Device Enchant:[/b] Skill cooldown reduced from 90 seconds to 60 seconds， and the duration will be increased from 40 to 60 seconds， Added a buff that increases physical attack by 10% in the additional effects

[b]Hawkeye: [/b]Within 5 seconds after the skill is cast, reduce self-damage by 80% [PVP not available]

[b]Laser Cannon: [/b]During the skill charging stage, reduce self-damage by 50% [PVP not available]， and skill damage increased by 35%/45%/60%/100% respectively

notes.title: Service Transition Announcement
notes.content:
Hello C9 Community!

It is never easy to make an announcement like this to a community, especially when it’s one that’s been as dedicated and helpful as you have for such a long time.

However, after numerous talks with all the teams involved with the C9 project, it is with a heavy heart that we announce C9 will no longer be serviced by Webzen and will instead be transferred to a new publishing partner, VALOFE on VFUN. A detailed date of transition will be announced later.

We are working with VALOFE to ensure there is a smooth transition between companies, with the priority being as little impact to yourselves as possible. You shall be able to transfer your characters over to new publisher during transfer period. We are aiming to start the transition on September 14th. (Schedule is subject to delay from target date). 

To keep things short, we just want to thank everyone for their continued support throughout the years - it was truly you, the community, who made the game what it is today.

That said, things are not going to stop right away, and we shall continue to offer you the best support and experience that we can until the handover.
Again, thank you to our community for being awesome and supportive.
Best,

[b]Please notice that your wcoin will not be transfer to VFUN. We would like to recommend spending your wcoin before the transition day. [/b]



Service Transition Plan from VFUN,

And to make your VFUN experience VeryFUN, we will be giving away gifts and goodies to players who will complete their migration!

You will also receive the following items:
- Goddess' Tears x1000
- Mysterious Egg
- Event Charm Chest [STR] [7 days]
- Sleeping Warrior's Soul: Mana Crafter
- Joker II

You can also check C9 news on VFUN Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/C9.VFUN/ 
We’re excited to see you all on our new home and meet new players and have new adventures await you. See you C9 actionists!!
VALOFE C9 Team
